title: Conditional κ = 0.000711457853376510: 887 entrances and connected-block retiming
body:
This improves the conditional exponent saving to **κ = 711457853376510082124745 / 10^27 = 0.000711457853376510082124745**, by composing 887 entrances with connected-block frame retiming.

**Stacked dependency:** this branch retains [PR265](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/265) at `fc00fcf07a554ff6847b2a8764ecc26f5a99542a`, including its PR259/263 history. For this contribution alone, use the [incremental comparison against PR265](https://github.com/utcorvusvolat-dotcom/integer-mult-bounds/compare/fc00fcf07a554ff6847b2a8764ecc26f5a99542a...codex/crosscut-improvement). Only `research/crosscut-response-pairs/`, its sibling evidence directory, and the dedicated workflow are added relative to that baseline. Inherited authorship and files are preserved.

## Construction and result

Retain all 518 original kernel entrances and their 25 gate retimings. Add 369 early-cut response pairs, contributing 372 entrance dimensions, then jointly retime 29 connected blocks containing 57 ADDs. The latter changes the charged rank distribution while preserving total calls and rank mass. Every additional basis gate, inverse, chart and selector remains charged; the full composition is priced from one emitted word.

| Quantity | PR265 | This candidate |
|---|---:|---:|
| Pivot entrances | 518 | 887 |
| Entrance dimension | 1,344 | 1,716 |
| Normalized stock | 173,435 | 173,311 |
| Normalized child calls | 3,956,800 | 3,970,720 |
| Normalized rank mass | 20,777,000 | 20,762,120 |
| Deficit | 35,200 | 35,200 |

The exact gain over PR265 is `425611242438074456938 / 10^27` (**0.05986%**). At the prepublication check, [PR266](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/266) head `b2b2a33dc95eb2d4ad9ddfade6bb9416ab9ec38e` reports 883 entrances, dimension 1710 and κ = `0.000711421336565136`; this endpoint is **0.00513294%** higher. That comparison uses its public claim, not an independent replay of its updated package.

## Verification

The complete local source-to-certificate replay passes: regenerate the pinned source, recompile the unchanged native checkers, reproduce PR265, construct the new word, bind both retiming stages by full scalar-core alignment, and rerun the native and exact arithmetic checks. Evidence is included in `research/crosscut-response-pairs-evidence/`.

Checks cover local forward/inverse columns; all 23,627 global columns; chronological nesting and COPY lifetimes; 916 rational bases, annihilators and weighted Gram matrices; all 3,317,400 bank assignments; exact integer operand source spans; the full finite invoice; two rational moment engines; finite cutoffs; 47 strict outer constraints and seven margins; and adjacent-grid rejection. Separate reproducible audits reject nine arithmetic and six frame corruptions.

`make entrance-bank-verify` also passed. A broader inherited `make verify` attempt was stopped before completion; no full-repository-suite pass is claimed.

The transcript SHA-256 is `8593fa0359aa13b26ede7490f500f239c97d238df2730496a9ac29bcafd7b4ae`.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/crosscut-response-pairs/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/crosscut-response-pairs/verify.py --output /tmp/crosscut-replay
```

Requires Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, C++17, Boost headers and a fresh output directory outside the checkout. No network is needed for replay. Local testing used macOS/Apple Clang; the added workflow runs Ubuntu/Python 3.11 and 3.13. CI status is reported by the checks, not assumed from the workflow definition.

## Attribution and scope

PR266 independently published closely related early-cut work; 316 of our 369 additions coincide exactly with its **earlier 851-entrance snapshot** `a2b02af47dbaf3d1c55e7586746c30e851b68102`. That overlap count is not claimed for its updated 883-entrance witness. [PR267](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/267) independently develops chronological donor sharing. This contribution is the concrete larger composition and connected-block retiming, not a priority claim for those directions. Full predecessor credits and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance are disclosed in `NOTICE.md`.

The result retains the inherited all-size compiler, common weighted chart, restored-row, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex correctness and analytic interfaces. It is not an unconditional multiplication theorem, practical-runtime benchmark or full Lean proof. No global-optimality claim is made.
